items.title: Who is Jimmy Tata? Meet the longest-serving Tata Trusts trustee and why is he backing the listing of Tata Sons
items.summary: Jimmy Tata, younger brother of Ratan Tata and a major Tata Sons shareholder, has backed listing the company and accused Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata of consolidating family control over the charitable trusts and their stake in the holding company.

items.title: Sai Parenterals to buy majority stake in Bion Therapeutics
items.summary: Bion will become a step-down subsidiary of SAI Parenterals on completion of the deal, which is expected before the end of this month in an all-cash deal.

items.title: States capex growth outpaces centre in FY26 and FY27: Report
items.summary: State government capital expenditure grew 14% in FY27 so far, ahead of the Centre’s 13%, supported by stronger state tax revenue growth, according to an ICICI Securities report.

items.title: India Inc.’s sudden craving for dollars is a dangerous gamble
items.summary: India's increasing reliance on US dollar borrowing poses potential risks for future financial stability and currency strength. The Reserve Bank of India has promoted overseas dollar raising, but this could lead to vulnerabilities. Strengthening dollar reserves through debt might not address underlying economic issues effectively.

items.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview: 6 key factors investors will watch
items.summary: Nvidia’s fiscal Q3 2027 earnings report will test the sustainability of the AI boom, with revenue expected to reach $108.9 billion. Investors will scrutinise Data Center growth, hyperscaler demand, Blackwell and Rubin chip rollouts, margins and future guidance, alongside leadership uncertainty and rising costs, to assess its growth outlook.

items.title: IPO-bound Jakson Green acquires Ocior Energy
items.summary: Ocior Energy has a pipeline of green molecules projects under development in India, West Africa and North Africa.

items.title: Australia sells A$6 billion of new 2057 Treasury bond
items.summary: The Australian government's debt management arm made a significant move by issuing A$6 billion in a new Treasury bond set to mature in June 2057, boasting a yield to maturity of 5.62%. With bids totaling A$25.25 billion, investor interest remains strong. The settlement for this issuance is earmarked for November 24, with no additional issuances expected until March 2027. Five prominent banks took lead roles in this…

items.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s daughter Madison allegedly berated Indian-origin exec Jay Puri | Here’s how he responded
items.summary: A New York Times report has shed light on Madison Huang’s growing influence at Nvidia, her alleged clashes with senior executives and concerns over her authority following the resignation of her father, Jensen Huang.

items.title: Indian bonds gain as oil slide eases rate hike concerns
items.summary: Indian government bonds saw an increase as oil prices dropped significantly in early trading. This decline in crude prices is expected to ease inflationary pressures and reduce concerns about aggressive rate hikes. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell to 7.2813% during early trading hours. Lower oil prices are particularly beneficial for India, supporting the local rupee and current account deficit.

items.title: Groww share price hits record high after massive ₹1,905 crore block deal: Key things to know - Should you buy?
items.summary: Groww-parent Billionbrains Garage Ventures rose 2.5% to a 52-week high after a ₹1,905 crore block deal involving 1.4% of its equity.

items.title: JGB yields climb as buyers hold back on long-dated debt
items.summary: Japanese government bond yields generally increased on Tuesday except for the benchmark 10-year yield, which fell. The 20-year and 30-year JGB yields reached their highest levels in about a month and since October. Investors are wary of taking interest-rate risks ahead of the 20-year bond auction. Concerns about falling equities may also affect bond supply-demand conditions amidst uncertainty.

items.title: Greaves Cotton rallies 9%, stock nears 52-week high; here's why
items.summary: In FY27, until November 15, 2026, Ampere - a Greaves Cotton electric 2-wheeler - recorded 70,333 VAHAN registrations, surpassing the 61,842 registrations recorded during the entire FY26.

items.title: Oil prices fall as supply surplus outlook outweighs tanker attack concerns
items.summary: Brent crude fell 0.5 per cent to $92 a barrel and US WTI declined to $85.28, as recovering Middle East exports fuelled expectations of a global supply surplus in the fourth quarter

items.title: Urban Company shares slip 2% as firm launches ₹2,500 crore QIP issue
items.summary: Among the funds raised, the company said ₹600 crore from the capital will go towards its InstaHelp business, a segment that offers households daily cleaning and housekeeping needs.

items.summary: Manish Syag, managing director of Mars Pet Nutrition, India, believes rivals will find it harder to replicate its scientific capabilities and consumer trust.

items.title: Tata Chemicals share price jumps 9%: Volume surge, Tata Sons listing buzz behind the Tata Group stock rally. Do you own?
items.summary: Tata Chemicals shares surged 9.3% to ₹669.05 as trading volumes climbed more than fivefold. Investor interest returned to the company’s estimated 2.5% to 3% stake in Tata Sons after the RBI reiterated that the holding company must comply with listing requirements for upper-layer NBFCs.

items.title: Why is Hindustan Zinc stock down despite ₹80,000 cr expansion plan? Decoded
items.summary: At the current price, Hindustan Zinc's stock trades at 6.2x FY28E EV/EBITDA, and MOFSL believes the current valuation has priced in all the positive factors.

items.title: Traders pour cash into BlackRock’s India ETF as AI rout deepens
items.summary: Investors poured over $316 million into BlackRock’s iShares MSCI India ETF last week, its largest weekly inflow since June 2025, as AI-related volatility drove diversification away from technology-heavy markets. Strong Indian equities, lower oil prices and improving earnings boosted sentiment, while foreign investors increasingly reversed their bearish positioning.

items.summary: The maker of Arm & Hammer and Trojan is preparing an India launch aimed at premium, online-first consumers

Investors are also monitoring Nvidia’s aggressive AI investments, future sales guidance and chip sales, as concerns grow about profitability and data-center expansion.

items.summary: India's wholesale inflation is currently anticipated to reach around 11 percent in FY27, surpassing earlier projections. Persistent pressures from energy and input costs alongside risks to food prices are significant factors. The report highlights that global commodity prices will greatly influence this inflation trajectory. A potential 25-basis-point rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India is also expected in…

items.title: SML Mahindra Rights Issue Details: ₹1,450 crore offer; check open date, price, record date, ratio and key details
items.summary: SML Mahindra has fixed its rights issue price at ₹3,506 per share, with eligible shareholders entitled to two shares for every seven held. The proceeds will primarily fund its acquisition of Mahindra's truck and bus business and support expansion plans.

items.title: Egypt, India aim to hit $12 bn bilateral trade target within five years, says Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty
items.summary: Egypt and India are aiming to increase bilateral trade to $12 billion over the next five years and expand Indian investment in the North African country, Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty said. The target was discussed during Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal's visit to Egypt with an Indian business delegation.
